See you! Good chatting with you! Have a great day!
Hey Nate, how's it going? I took your reccomendation and watched "The Lord of the Rings" Trilogy last night! It was awesome!
Glad to hear you enjoyed it! It's probably the greatest trilogy of all time! As for me, life's been ok, just taking care of this.
Wow, Nate! I'm proud of what you did. Your gaming room looks great - have you been gaming a lot recently?
Gaming has been my focus - practicing a lot and even winning a few tournaments. Last week I won my second tournament!

It was super awesome! So much adrenaline went into that last match, and the other finalist even shook my hand! Enough about me though, how about you? What have you been up to?
Not much is new other than the screenplay. Been working on some projects and testing out dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and fam. Here's a pic of a cake I made recently!
That looks really good! I love the way the frosting turned out!
Thanks! It's dairy-free vanilla with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting. I gotta say, I really like your coconut reccomendation you gave a while back!
Wow, Joanna, that looks amazing! I bet it tastes great - you're so talented at making dairy-free desserts!

Thanks Nate! I really appreciate it. I love experimenting in the kitchen, coming up with something tasty. Cooking and baking are my creative outlets. Especially when I'm snackin' dairy-free, trying to make the desserts just as delicious - it's a rewarding challenge! Seeing the smiles on everyone's faces when they try it - it's a total win!
That's great, Joanna! It must be so rewarding to see everyone enjoying your creations. Keep up the good work!
Thanks, Nate! Appreciate all the help. Gonna keep trying new things. See ya later!
Bye!
Hey Nate! Great to hear from you! Quite a week since we last talked - something awesome happened to me!
Hey Jo! Great hearing from you! What happened?
I went hiking and found some more amazing trails in my town. It was such an awesome experience! I think I am an expert hiker now.
Sounds great, Jo! Happy you had an awesome experience. Did you happen to take any photos of it?
Yeah, I did! Loved this spot on the hike. The rush of the water was so soothing.
Wow, looks great! Where did you take this picture? I love the dark sky and green scenery.
Thanks! I took this photo at a beautiful location called Whispering Falls. It was really peaceful and serene.
I wish I could have been there! Your hikes sound like a blast.
It was awesome, Nate. The sound of that place and the beauty of nature made me so calm and peaceful. Everything else faded away and all that mattered was the present.
That's great. Glad you found a spot that calms you down - nature sure can be a break from the craziness.
Nature totally inspires me and it's so calming to be surrounded by its beauty. Hiking has opened up a whole new world for me and I feel like a different person now.
Wow, Jo, that's really cool! It's great to have something that gets those creative juices flowing.
I always feel like I could write a whole movie when I'm out there in cool places like that!
Wow! That's really cool that it inspires you that much! For me I just get deep in thought and think about my life or new recipes.
I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.
Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.

Thanks, Nate. I'll keep you posted. Have a great day.

Woah Joanna, I won an international tournament yesterday! It was wild. Gaming has brought me so much success and now I'm able to make a living at something I'm passionate about - I'm loving it.

I'm really stoked to see all my hard work paying off! I'm super proud of what I accomplished. On another note, my little dudes got a new tank! Check them out, they're so cute, right?!

I'm taking some time off this weekend to chill with my pets. Anything cool happening with you?
I'm relaxing and recharging this weekend with a long walk and some reading. It's a good break.

Good idea! How about this series?
That's a great one! Let me know what you think when your finished!

Hey Joanna! Long time no talk. So much has happened. Look how cute they are! Hanging with them has been a big help, especially recently. Speaking of which, I just had a letdown in a video game tourney - I didn't do too great, even though I tried. It was a setback, but I'm trying to stay positive.

Bye Joanna! Good luck!
Hey Nate, long time no see! My laptop crashed last week and I lost all my work - super frustrating! As a writer, my laptop is like half of my lifeline so losing all progress was like a major blow.
Hey Joanna, sorry to hear about that. Losing so much progress must be really frustrating. Did you manage to recover anything? Maybe consider backing up your work in the future?
Thanks for the sympathy, Nate. Nothing was recoverable, but now I have an external drive for backups. I never want to go through this again. So, how have you been? Making anything cool?

Hey Joanna, I'm no writer like you, but something pretty awesome happened. Last Monday I got to teach people vegan ice cream recipes on my own cooking show! It was a bit nerve-wracking to put myself out there, but it was a blast. Plus, I picked up a few new recipes!
Way to go, Nate! Congrats on the cooking show, I'll definitely be tuning in! What's your favorite dish from the show?

Coconut milk ice cream is at the top of my list. It's so smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist. Plus, it's dairy-free for people who can't have lactose or who want vegan options. Here's a snap of the ice cream I made.
Wow, that looks amazing, Nate! I love the color and texture. It's great that you're making these options. Could you share the recipe? I'd love to try making it sometime!
Yeah sure! Would love to share it. Let's spread the joy of dairy-free options! Let me know when you make it!

Cool, Nate! Gonna give it a go. Dairy-free is a must for me, especially for desserts. Last Friday, I made a deeeelish dessert with almond milk - it was good! Got any favs when it comes to dairy-free desserts?

Coconut milk ice cream is one of my favorites as you might be able to tell, but I also love a dairy-free chocolate mousse. It's super creamy and tastes like the real thing. What's been your favorite dairy-free sweet treat so far?
Hey Nate, my favorite dairy-free treat is this amazing chocolate raspberry tart. It has an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries - it's delicious!
That looks amazing, Joanna! I need to try baking that. What other treats do you like making?
Hey Nate, I love making this dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries. It's so moist and delicious - perfect sweetness level.
That cake looks amazing, Joanna! How did you make it?
I make it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries. It's my favorite for birthdays and special days.
Yum, Joanna! Gotta try that one. Any others you want to share?
Hey Nate! Here's another recipe I like. It's a delicious dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk, and a gluten-free crust. So creamy and delicious!
Wow, Joanna! That dessert looks amazing. I'll definitely have to give it a try. Thanks!
Glad to help, Nate. Let me know if you try it. I'm sure you'll enjoy it. It was great chatting.
Thanks Joanna! I will. Bye!
Hey Nate, hi! Yesterday, I tried my newest dairy-free recipe and it was a winner with my family! Mixing and matching flavors is fun and I'm always trying new things. How about you?
Hey Joanna! That tart looks yummy! Lately, I've been doing great - I won a really big video game tournament last week and it was awesome! I still can't believe I made so much money from it.
Way to go, Nate! Winning the tournament and earning cash is awesome - congrats! Did you save it for something special?
Thanks Joanna! Yeah, I saved some but I'm not sure what to do with it - I'm completely content already. I don't have big plans anyway, so it's nice to have the extra cash on hand.
That's awesome, Nate! Having some extra cash on hand definitely brings a sense of freedom and relaxation, huh?
Yes! Finally, I don't have to stress about it, so I can just enjoy my movies and games.
Taking breaks and reducing stress is pretty nice! Have you watched any good movies recently? I could use some recommendations!
I watched "Little Women" recently, and it was great! The acting was awesome and the story was so captivating. Definitely a good one!

I'm so glad you enjoyed it! I recommended it to you a while back. I watched it too and it really spoke to me. Themes like sisterhood, love, and chasing dreams were explored so well. By the way, I finished up my writing for my book last week. Put in a ton of late nights and edits but finally got it done. I'm so proud of it! Can't wait to see what happens next.
Way to go! We both know it took some effort, but I'm sure it'll be great. Congrats on finishing it up!
Thanks Nate! Your words mean a lot. Dedication and late nights got me here, but it was worth it. Just like you with your recent tournament - hard work pays off. I appreciate your support throughout!
I'm always here for you, Joanna! You've worked so hard and accomplished a lot – I'm proud. Keep on going!
Thanks, Nate! I won't give up on my goals as long as your here to support me.
You can always count on me! I even made this for you!
Wow, Nate, that looks awesome! What inspired you?
I figured you could always look back on this whenever you need encouragement, and that was all the inspiration I needed. And I would also say that your life path can be quite inspirational!
Wow, Nate! That's sweet of you! I'll make sure to remember this when I need the encouragement the most.
Awesome! I know encouragement is what got me so far in my gameing career, so I figured why not share the love.
Rest assured, it will be something I cherish! On another note, I just finished this cute little bookmark for one of the ladies at my writing club!
That bookmark is great. I'm sure she'll love it!
Thanks Nate! I absolutley love DIYs, and I know she does too.
Let me know how it goes!
Sure thing! Bye for now!

Hey Joanna, it's been a couple days since we last talked. Something exciting happened last Friday. I went to a game convention and met new people who weren't from my normal circle. It was a bit overwhelming but it reminded me of the good times gaming can bring.
Hey Nate! Good to hear from you. Sounds like fun! Meeting new people can be overwhelming, but the rewards can be great. Sometimes it's good to step outside our comfort zones and explore new things.

Yeah, you're right! We can have great experiences if we take risks. I even made some friends at the convention who love games just like me. We already planned a gaming session together - it's cool to meet people who have the same interests!
That looks awesome! I'm glad you met people who share your interests - that definitely makes experiences more fun..
I also met some people who also played this boardgame I love, so I joined in. We had a lot in common and hit it off. It's great when shared hobbies can bond people!
It's incredible how a game can bring people together and form strong relationships. Did you do anything else there?
We played this game Catan - it's a great strategy game where you build settlements and trade resources. I love it!
Looks cool! Is it more of a competitive game or a more chill one?
It can be both competitive and chill. We were competing, but still had lots of fun.
Competitive games can definitely be difficult to play sometimes when people get all upset about every move you make, but it's cool they were all chill! Glad you had a good time.
It was great! Playing games is my escape from life struggles, so I generally don't get crazy competitive over them. The people at the convention were the same way!
Glad you found a way to have fun and escape! It's important to stay happy and de-stress. Keep doing what makes you happy!
For sure! You should go to a writing convention or something sometime! The experience at this convention is unforgetable.
Do writing conventions exist? I'll have to look into that, it could be fun! Thanks for the idea. Have you been up to anything tonight?
Mostly just chilling at home. Playing video games or watching movies helps me unwind.
That sounds great! What's your favorite game or movie that you've seen recently?

I recently saw a movie that blew my mind with all the twists and dream stuff, I think it was called "Inception". I've also been playing a game nonstop with a great futuristic setting and gameplay called "Cyberpunk 2077". Have you seen or played anything good lately?
I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.
Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?
Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?
Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.
I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!
Wow, it's so comfy in there! I should really get a set up like that.
You should! It's one thing to watch a movie in a theater, but on a nice comfy couch with a good blanket, I feel so at peace!
Any pointers on what I should get for my living room to make it comfy like that?

Sure! For one, you should get a couch that can sit multiple people so that you can lay down if you want, and make sure its really fluffy! Also invest in a blanket that has a little bit of weight to it, and some lights that can be dimmed.
Sounds like you really got into making your living room! Thanks, I'll try that out for myself!
No problem! I get super invested in random little things like that, but I think its all worth it when I end up with random little things that make life so much nicer.
Thanks for the tip! See you later!
See ya Nate!
Hey Joanna, what's been up? Haven't seen you since we last talked.
Hey Nate! I have been revising and perfecting the recipe I made for my family and it turned out really tasty. What's been happening with you?
Hey Joanna! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.
Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.
Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?

I used to have a dog back in Michigan with that name, but then I got allergic and we had to get rid of her. The name helps me remember her back when I used to be able to hold and squeeze animal without an allergic reaction!
That's so touching! Glad the stuffed animal means so much!
Tilly helps me stay focused and brings me so much joy. It's amazing how even stuffed animals can do that!
It really is, I'm not sure I'll ever understand why watching my turtles slowly walk around makes me so happy. But I'm very glad it does.
Same here! So have you been up to anything recenly?
Yeah, I've just been practicing for my next video game tournemant. How about you?
Well, I had a bit of a setback recently - another rejection from a production company.
Bummer, Joanna. Is this the one you sent to a film contest? Rejections suck, but don't forget they don't define you. Keep at it and you'll find the perfect opportunity.
Yeah.. Thanks, Nate. It's hard, but I won't let it slow me down. I'm gonna keep grinding and moving ahead.
That's what I like to hear! I really respect you for that and being able to bounce back whenever something sad happens!
Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and believing in myself.
You got this, and don't ever forget that you have people cheering you on from the sidelines wherever you go.
Thanks! I'll see you around!
No problem! Catch you later!
Hey Joanna, what's been up since we last chatted? How's it going?

Hey Nate! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!

Congrats Joanna! How was it to finally see it on the big screen?

[shares a photo holding a videogame controller]

It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!
That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?
Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.
Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?
Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.
That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?
I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!
You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!
Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?
I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.
Sound fun! Did they have a good time?
Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.
Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?
They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.
Wow, that's fascinating! It's interesting how they have such a varied diet, including insects. Do you have a favorite among their food choices?
I love seeing them eat fruit - they get so hyped and it's so cute!
Wow, that's so cute! They look like they really enjoy fruit.
Yeah, it's adorable! Watching them enjoy their favorite snacks is so fun. I also like holding them.
Do they have different personalities, like the way dogs and cats do?
Yeah, they each do. One is more adventurous while the other is more reserved, which I find cute. Having them around brings me joy and they make great companions.
That's super cool! I never knew turtles could be so interesting until I met your turtles. Wow!
I've always liked turtles since I was a boy, so I know all about them!
You'll have to keep me posted on them! It's been fun chatting!
See you later Joanna!
Wow, Nate, I'm on fire! I just set up meetings with movie producers — my dreams are comin' true!
Wow Joanna, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?

Thanks, Nate! The meetings went really well. I felt confident discussing my script and vision and they seemed interested and excited. They loved the elements of self-discovery in it. It was so validating to be taken seriously. I'm feeling hopeful and inspired about the future!

Way to go, Joanna! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.

Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.
That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?

Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.
You obviously have a passion for writing, and it's funny the story was about a turtle! Their resilience is so inspiring! Take courage and keep pushing yourself with your writing. Great job!
Thanks, Nate! They make me think of strength and perseverance. They help motivate me in tough times - glad you find that inspiring!
What can I say, I love turtles. So, what's been happening with you?
Hey Nate! Apart from meetings, I'm working on a project - challenging but fulfilling. How about you? What's been going on?
Just been helping some friends reset their high scores at the international tournament. It's been fun!
Wow, sounds like so much fun! You're really passionate about gaming. Have an awesome time and keep helping others with those high scores!
Thanks! It feels good to use my skills to make a difference.
I couldn't agree more! Which is why my meetings are so exciting!
On another note, want to come over and try some of this? It's super yummy, just made it yesterday!
Mmm, that looks delicious! Is it lactose-free by any chance?
Yep, I made it with coconut milk so it's lactose-free!
Thanks so much, Nate! Sure! I'll come over tomorrow if that's fine.
I don't see why not! I'm not doing anything then, so your completely welcome to!
Awesome! I'll bring some of my recipes so we can both share deserts!
I'd love that! I've been wanting to try some of your chocolate and rasberry cake for a while now.
You got it! See you tomorrow!
See you then! Take care!

Hey Joanna! Hope you’re doing alright. Crazy thing happened - I was in the final of a big Valorant tournament last Saturday, and I won! It was the best feeling to see my name as the champion. Tournaments really bring out strong emotions in me.

Hey Nate! Congrats on winning the tournament - that's awesome! I know you must have been buzzing! Anyway, I've been working on something exciting too. Last Friday, I finished the presentation for producers - it was tough but it's looking good. What have you been up to?
Thanks, Joanna! I've been having a blast and preparing for other tournaments, so I've been real busy - but I'm loving it!
Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!
Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?
I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.

Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?
Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!
Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?
Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.
Well with dedication like yours, its no wonder you do so well in it as well! Are you planning on submitting anymore scripts anytime soon?
Yep! I actually just submitted a few more last week! Hoping to hear back from them soon, though I assume a few will be rejected.
Even if it happens to a few, I'm sure at leasts one will make it to the screens and be your 3rd published movie!
Thanks, Nate! Appreciate the encouragement. I won't give up, I promise! Got it covered!
Great to hear! On another note, I just upgraded some of my equipment at home. Check it out!
Oh wow, ice set-up! Do you use that computer for gaming?
Yep! This is where I practice and compete. Sometimes I even use it when I'm playing games with friends.
Cool! Having a dedicated space for practice and competition should help you stay focused.
Yeah, I love it. It's like my own little haven to escape into the virtual world.
Wow, that sounds great to have your own gaming setup at home. It must be really awesome!
It really is! But it's also really important to have something like this for my career, otherwise I would never be able to beat my competition.
That makes sense! It's all about practice isn't it? So what's your favorite game?
Yep! I'm currently playing this awesome fantasy RPG called "Xeonoblade Chronicles" and it's been a blast! I highly reccomend it if you've never played it before.
What made you start playing it? That's a japanese game series right?
Yes it is! I'm a big fan of Nintendo games, and I've actually been wanting to play this one for a while because my friends have played it and reccomended it!
Nice! It's really cool when a reccomendation from a friend fits your taste so well isn't it?
For sure! That's why I love when you give me movie reccomendations, I usually like them a lot more then if I were to just watch some random one.
Great to hear! I just finished with the intro to my next movie script, and I decided to include this at the begining.
That letter is really awesome! Does it remind you of your childhood?
Yeah, it does! My brother wrote it - he used to make me these cute notes when we were kids. Brings back sweet memories.
Aww, childhood memories can be so powerful!
They sure can! They take us back to simpler times but it's nice to create new memories as we grow up.

Totally! I had a special day when I took my pets to the park. They were amazed and seeing their happy faces made it a memorable day. Mixing the new with the old is priceless - I treasure every memory!
That sounds so sweet, Nate! I started writing some of my favorite memories down.
Dang, your full of great ideas Joanna! I really should start doing that as well, or at least write down the things my animals like a lot!
You should! I completely encourage it, looking back on fond memories is such a blessing.
Ok I will! But I'll also start writing down some of my favorite memories with you from now on.
Definitely, let's keep making great memories and supporting each other. Let's keep reaching for our dreams and make them happen!
Hey Joanna, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.
Hey Nate, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?
Hey Joanna, thanks! Tough tournament, didn't make it to the finals. But that's okay, I'll get 'em next time!
Aww, bummer! But the important thing is to stay positive. So, what's your next move in the gaming world?

Thanks Joanna! Staying positive is key. I'm thinking of joining a new gaming team after this next tourney - I've had a few offers, but I haven't decided yet. It's gonna be a big step, but I'm ready for a shake up.
Sounds great, Nate! Making a switch could open up new opportunities. Wishing you luck with picking the right team!
Thanks, Joanna! I really appreciate it. It's a big decision, but I'm excited for what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening on your end?

Yup! I worked hard on another script and eventually created a plan for getting it made into a movie. It was a ton of work but satisfying. I pitched it to some producers yesterday and they really liked it. It gave me a big confidence boost!
Congrats on the chance to pitch your script - super impressive. Proud of you!
Appreciate you, Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I feel like I just can't stop writing write now!
Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?
Hey Nate, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?
Yeah actually - creating gaming content for YouTube. It's a cool way to entertain folks and satisfy my video game cravings at the same time when there aren't any tourneys going on.
Wow, that's a cool idea! What inspired you to start making gaming videos?
Hey Joanna, I'm a big fan of them and thought it would be a fun idea to start making them myself. I'm hoping to share my love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it too.
Way to go, Nate! Making videos and connecting with people about gaming - that's awesome! You'll do great!
Thanks Joanna! Appreciate the support. It's new to me but I'm excited to get started!
Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.
Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!
No worries, Nate! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!
Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?
Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.

That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!
Wow, what made you get a third?

Turtles really bring me joy and peace. They have such an effect on us - best buddies ever! I saw another at a pet store and just hade to get him. The tank is big enough now for three, so I figured why not!
Wow! It's always a shock where life will take us next! I bet just last week you would have never thought you would be getting a third turtle this year!
You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way.
Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic.
Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!
For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!
Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play.
Alright, see you tomorrow!
Bye Joanna!
Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!

Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!
Woohoo, thanks Nate! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome.
I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?
One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!

Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.
Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?

Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.
That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.

Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.
Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.
Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?
Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!
No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!
Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!

question: How many turtles do I have now?

haystack_sessions.content: Hey Joanna! Long time no see! What's up? Anything fun going on?
Hey Nate! Long time no see! I've been working on a project lately - it's been pretty cool. What about you - any fun projects or hobbies?
Hey Joanna! That's cool! I won my first video game tournament last week - so exciting!
Wow Nate! Congrats on winning! Tell me more - what game was it?
Thanks! it's a team shooter game.
Wow, great job! What was is called?
The game was called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and me and my team had a blast to the very end!
Cool, Nate! Sounds like a fun experience, even if I'm not into games.
It was! How about you? Do you have any hobbies you love?
Yeah! Besides writing, I also enjoy reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Anything else you enjoy doing, Nate?
Playing video games and watching movies are my main hobbies.
Cool, Nate! So we both have similar interests. What type of movies do you like best?
I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?
I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots.
Wow, movies can be so powerful! Do you have any recommendations for me?
Yeah, totally! Have you seen this romantic drama that's all about memory and relationships? It's such a good one.
Oh cool! I might check that one out some time soon! I do love watching classics.
Yep, that movie is awesome. I first watched it around 3 years ago. I even went out and got a physical copy!
Sounds cool! Have you seen it a lot? sounds like you know the movie well!
A few times. It's one of my favorites! I really like the idea and the acting.
Cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!
No problem, Nate! Let me know if you like it!
Hey Nate! Haven't talked in a few days. Crazy things happened to me!
Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!
Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!
Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!
Thanks, Nate! It's a mix of drama and romance!
Wow, that's amazing! How do you feel now that it's finished? Do you have any new plans for it?

Woohoo, Nate! I'm feeling a rollercoaster of emotions - relief, excitement, some anxiety - over finishing this project. Now I'm gonna submit it to some film festivals and (hopefully) get producers and directors to check it out. Here's hoping!
Congrats, Joanna! That sounds like a wild experience. Rock on and I hope they love it!
Thanks Nate! A mix of emotions for sure. Hopefully, it leads to positive feedback and new opportunities.
Yeah, for sure. Hoping for the best! I like having some of these little ones around to keep me calm when things are super important and I'm nervous.
Awww! How long have you had them?
I've had them for 3 years now and they bring me tons of joy!
They sure lookl like they do! Adorable!
Thanks! The turtles might be small, but both sure have big personalities. I really reccomend having something like these little guys for times of stress.
Good idea, Nate! I'll think about it and maybe get pets of my own soon if I can find any I'm not allergic to. Have you been up to anything recently?
Yeah actually! I start to hang out with some people outside of my circle at the tournament. They're pretty cool!
Oh? That sounds sweet! Is it a weird relationship with them being competitors and all?
Oh, kind of. Some people are more competitive then others, so I tend to just stick around the more chill people here.
That makes sense! Are you gonna cheer them on even if you lose?
Absolutely! I don't expect to win big here, I just like playing for fun!  You mentioned you were allergic to pets earlier, how bad is it?
Oh, its really bad. My face gets all puffy and itchy when I'm around certain animals, so I've always just stayed away.
Sorry to hear that. Allergies can be tough. What specifically are you allergic to?
I'm allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur. It can be a bit of a drag, but I find other ways to be happy.

Writing and hanging with friends! That way I can express myself through stories, or just have a good time with people.

Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.
Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!
Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.

Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!

I love coconut milk, but I also enjoy chocolate and mixed berry flavors.
Wow, those sound great! Who can say no to chocolate and berries? I'm tempted to try dairy-free flavors now!

Wow! That sounds yummy! You're so talented. Thanks for sharing your amazing creations! I should really try making one or just pay you a visit and try one for myself!
I couldn't agree more! It's always fun experimenting in the kitchen.
I can tell! Your cooking skills are awesome. Seen any good movies lately?
Not recently. Any good ones you'd recommend?

Oh, that sounds like a great one! I'll definitely add it to my list. Thanks for the recommendation!
Anytime! I'm always down to give movie reccomendations.

Sounds great! Let me know what you think of it when your done!

Hey Joanna! Sorry I haven't been around. I made my friend some ice cream and they loved it!

Definitely keeping you posted! Love your creations!
Thanks, Joanna! It means a lot that you enjoy the desserts I bake.
Yeah Nate, your cooking is amazing! I can't stop thinking about the screenplay, so I just started writing another one while I wait to hear back about how the first one did.
I hear that, taking your mind of something like that is very challenging. What's the new one about?
It's about a thirty year old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. Somewhat similar to the last one, but hey, that's just the kind of thing I'm inspired to write about!
Interesting! That's a deep topic. Love to hear more about it.
Thanks, Nate! It's my own story. The main character is dealing with some tough stuff: loss and trying to figure out who they are. They take a road trip to heal and grow.
Wow, Joanna, that sounds awesome. I love stories that tackle important issues. What inspired you to this one?
Thanks, Nate! It was inspired by personal experiences and my own journey of self-discovery.
Wow, Joanna, that takes guts! I can't wait to see it all come together. I'm also pumped to see how your first one will do!
Thanks, Nate! Appreciate your support. Hoping my screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen. Fingers crossed!
Crossing my fingers for you! Hope your screenplay finds a fan and is given its due. Good luck!

Hey Nate, it's been a minute! I wrapped up my second script, and the feels have been wild. Sometimes I'm so relieved, but other times I just feel anxious about what comes next. It's a mix of excitement and terror, thinking about my work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.

Hey Joanna! Awesome to hear from you! Congrats on wrapping up a second one! All that hard work and dedication will definitely shine through and get noticed, no doubt. Hope you've been able to take some time to relax after everything!
Thanks Nate! It's been a wild ride. I've been decompressing, but it's hard to switch off. There's always this tug-of-war of hope and doubt.

It's normal to have doubts, but you've worked hard and put tons of passion into it. Believe in yourself and things will work out. Here, look at this cute pic - walking them always reminds me to enjoy the small stuff!
That pic's adorable! They always look so relaxed outside. What made you choose them as pets?
I'm drawn to turtles. They're unique and their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life. They're also low-maintenance and calming. Check out this moment I snapped!
They look so peaceful! It's amazing how these creatures bring so much calm and joy. Is taking care of them tough?
No, not really. Just keep their area clean, feed them properly, and make sure they get enough light. It's actually kind of fun.
Sounds great! Having pets must be a wonderful experience.
Pets definitely bring tons of joy. They are always there for us and they're so cute! Relaxing with them is a great way to chill.
I wish I wasn't allergic! I would get two turtles today if I could! I found out recently I'm allergic to cockroaches as well, so who knows if I'll ever get a pet.
Sorry! Maybe there are other animals you could consider! In the meantime though, I'll be sure to send you pics of my turtles so you can still watch them grow without getting too close.
Great idea! I'm already really invested in those little guys!
Pets really seem to do that to everyone don't they! So, what about your script now? Any ideas for the next steps?
I've been doing my fair share of research and networking non-stop for it. It's tough, but I'm determined to make it happen.
Great idea! that should hopefully get some more eyes on it. Keep up the hard work!
Thanks so much, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll keep working at it and hopefully the next steps will become clearer soon.
Just make sure you don't quit - the path forward will show up soon. You got this!
Appreciated! I think just having someone to support me throughout the whole process is such a blessing. It gives me the motivation to keep pushing forward.
Glad to hear my support makes a difference, Joanna. I'm here for you!
Always good to hear! See you later!
Hey Joanna! Long time no talk, how's it going? Crazy stuff's been happening since we last chatted.
Hey Nate! Been quite a ride - in a good way - had an audition yesterday for a writing gig.
Congrats! How did it go? Are you excited?
Thanks, Nate! It went alright. Mixed emotions - definitely excited but also a bit anxious. Keep those fingers crossed!
Yeah, I get it. Mixed emotions are rough, but I have faith in you! Keep me posted - you got this!
Thanks, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll make sure to keep you updated. Anything new on your end?
Yeah actually - I'm currently participating in the video game tournament again and it's INTENSE! There's so much adrenaline flowing.

Best of luck in the tournament! It sounds like it would be difficult to go through so many days of intense gaming! This is my go-to place for writing inspiration. It helps me stay sharp and motivated.
Wow, that's a lot of books. Do you have any advice for someone like me who wants to pursue writing?

Definitely! Read lots and try out different genres. Build a solid understanding of literature. Don't be afraid to write and share, even if it's just with friends. Practicing and gathering feedback will make you better. Have faith in yourself and continue following your writing dreams - it's tough but worth it.
Thanks, Joanna. Really appreciate your help and kind words. I'm going to keep working hard on it and see what happens. Good luck with your project, I'm sure it will turn out great!
Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words and support. Let's keep going for our dreams and work hard. Catch you later!
Bye Joanna! Take care!
Hey Jo, guess what I did? Dyed my hair last week - come see!
Wow, Nate! Can't wait to see it. Must feel so liberating! How're you feeling?
I'm so stoked about it! Check it out!
Wow, your new hair color looks amazing! What made you choose that shade? Tell me all about it!
Thanks Jo! I picked this color because it's bright and bold - like me! I wanted to stand out from the regular options.
That's amazing, Nate! Your boldness really inspired me. It reminded me of this gorgeous sunset I saw while hiking the other day. It made me realize the importance of showing the world who we are.
Wow, that sunset looks awesome! Jealous! I bet you had a great time. Are there any more exciting trips coming up for you?
I did! the sky was so gorgeous! Wish I had a vacation lined up, but right now my writing is consuming me. Hoping for some good news soon!
I understand, Joanna. Big projects can be so taxing. Keep me posted on how it goes, alright?
Cheers, Nate! Your support means a lot. I'll definitely keep you updated.
Sounds great, See you soon?
Totally! Bye Nate!
Take care!
Hey Joanna! Haven't talked with you in a while - how's it going?
Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. I've been reading a lot in the past week! There's a lot of good books I forgot I owned.
Sounds fun! I probably also have loads of books I haven't read in years. Sounds like a blast from the past!

It really is! On a different note, I found an awesome hiking trail in my hometown yesterday! It was gorgeous. Nature is so inspiring, and it's a great way to reset. Do you know of any good hiking spots?
I'm not really into hiking but I'm curious to see what the trail looks like! I heard there's a nice trail just north of where I live.
Maybe I'll have to convince you to go with me one of these times!
Maybe! I do like nature, so that might be fun going with someone else.
Yeah, nature's awesome! I'm a huge fan of it, that's why I go!
Agreed, nature has a way of being so inspiring! I'm glad you found a way to reset and find peace in it.
Nature's always been my haven. Walking in it, feeling it, hearing the sounds - it's so calming. Worries and stress seem to vanish, and it's just me and the beauty around me.

It's so crucial to find a little peace and remember life's beauty. For me, it's spending time with my pets and engaging in my hobbies; they let me take a break from reality. It's wild how small things can have such a powerful effect on our happiness, right?

Yeah, Nate! Even the small things make life enjoyable and worth it. Taking time for your little friends and doing activities you love are like treasures that remind us how great and peaceful life is. We just gotta savor them!

So cute! I love your turtles so much!

I love your icecream so much! I wish I could make it the way you do!

Sure! I'm lactose intolerant, so I'll just need the dairy-free recipe!
No prob. I made it with coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt. After chilling it in the fridge, I put it in the ice cream maker and froze it until it was scoopable.
Wow, sounds delicious! I'm going to try making it tonight! Thank you for sharing the recipe!
Hey Joanna, glad I could help. Let me know how it turns out!
Got it, Nate. I'll definitely let you know how it turns out. Thanks for sharing the recipe!

Hey Nate! Long time no talk! I wanted to tell ya I just joined a writers group. It's unbelievable--such inspirational people who really get my writing. I'm feeling so motivated and supported, it's like I finally belong somewhere!

Thanks Nate! I'm gonna keep writing, but if acting calls out I might give it a try. I really enjoy dramas and emotionally-driven films. What about you? What inspires your passion?
I love fantasy and sci-fi movies, they're a great escape and get my imagination going. Playing video games is a great way to express my creativity and passion.

Wow, Nate! I'm proud of what you did. Your gaming room looks great - have you been gaming a lot recently?

Not much is new other than the screenplay. Been working on some projects and testing out dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and fam. Here's a pic of a cake I made recently!
That looks really good! I love the way the frosting turned out!

Wow, Joanna, that looks amazing! I bet it tastes great - you're so talented at making dairy-free desserts!

Thanks Nate! I really appreciate it. I love experimenting in the kitchen, coming up with something tasty. Cooking and baking are my creative outlets. Thanks, Nate! Appreciate all the help. Gonna keep trying new things. See ya later!
Bye!
Hey Nate! Great to hear from you! Quite a week since we last talked - something awesome happened to me!
Hey Jo! Great hearing from you! What happened?
I went hiking and found some more amazing trails in my town. It was such an awesome experience! I think I am an expert hiker now.
Sounds great, Jo! Happy you had an awesome experience. Did you happen to take any photos of it?
Yeah, I did! Loved this spot on the hike. The rush of the water was so soothing.

Thanks! I took this photo at a beautiful location called Whispering Falls. It was really peaceful and serene.

That's great. Glad you found a spot that calms you down - nature sure can be a break from the craziness.
Nature totally inspires me and it's so calming to be surrounded by its beauty. Hiking has opened up a whole new world for me and I feel like a different person now.
Wow, Jo, that's really cool! It's great to have something that gets those creative juices flowing.
I always feel like I could write a whole movie when I'm out there in cool places like that!

I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.
Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.

Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!
Sure thing Nate! See you later!
See ya!
Hey Joanna! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.
Hey Nate! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!
Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!
Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!
Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.
Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.
Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?
Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.
Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?
Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.
Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.

Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!
Wow, that looks great Joanna! Is that your third one?

Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.
That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.

Thanks, Nate! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.
Well done, Joanna! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!
Thanks, Nate! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.
No worries, Joanna! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!

Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.
Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. Sounds like a nice encounter on your walk. Connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding.
It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!
Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?
They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!
That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Nate!
Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.
I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.
Yep, Joanna. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!
Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Nate!
Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.
That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!
Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.
That's great, Nate! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!
Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!
I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!
Sure, Joanna! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!
Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.
Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.
Appreciating the journey and being aware of those happy moments can be a game-changer! It keeps us focused on our dreams. Can't wait to show it to you. I value your opinion!
Can't wait to see it, Joanna! I'm here to support you.
Thanks, Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!
Nate, after finishing my screenplay I got a rejection letter from a major company. It really bummed me out.
Sorry to hear that, Joanna. Rejection stinks, but it doesn't mean you're not talented. Don't give up on your dreams!
Thanks, Nate. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.
Sure, just make sure you keep going and believing in yourself. Did something happen with the company?
They just sent me a generic rejection letter without much feedback. It's disheartening not knowing why it didn't work out.
Ugh, that's so frustrating. But don't get discouraged, just keep going.
Yeah, you're right. I won't let this bring me down. Thanks for your support. What have you been up to lately?
I've been doing great - I just won another regional video game tournament last week! It was so cool, plus I met some new people. Connecting with fellow gamers is always awesome.
Way to go, Nate! Congratulations on your victory in the tournament! It must feel great to be recognized for your gaming skills.
Thanks, Joanna! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.
I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!
Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!
Anytime Nate! I'm here for you every step of the way.
I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!
Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!
For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.
Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.
Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?
Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?
Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!
Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?
Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.
Sounds like fun, Nate! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!
Thanks Joanna! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!
Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.
I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!
Thanks Nate! See you later!
Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!

Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?

Thanks, Nate! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?
That's great, Joanna! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!
Wow, Nate! That's awesome. I love the tech and funny jokes of Iron Man too. What made you get that figure?
Thanks Joanna! I got it because it reminded me of something I love. Its presence in my room is a good reminder to keep working on my goals. Any inspiring things in your room?
My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.
Wow Joanna, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?
Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.
That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?
Thanks, Nate! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.
That's great, Joanna. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.
Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.
I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!
I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.
Of course! Well see you later Joanna!
Bye Nate!
Hey Nate, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!
That's really cool Joanna! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.

Most of them did! I can't say if all of them will continue to use them or not, but that's beside the point.
Yeah Nate, you're right. It doesn't matter if they use it, its the thought that matters right?
Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!
That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!
Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!
Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!
Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?
Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!

Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!

Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!

Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.

Hey Joanna! Long time no talk. So much has happened. Look how cute they are! Hanging with them has been a big help, especially recently. Speaking of which, I just had a letdown in a video game tourney - I didn't do too great, even though I tried. It was a setback, but I'm trying to stay positive.
